question: Can a smaller linear readout carry the original nonlinear FFN features well enough to preserve whole-model answers, before studying continual readout adaptation?
status: independent fixed starting-function experiment; not a complete framework or OSFT causal explanation
evidence: Previous fixed gate/up replacements lost answers before adaptation; local block fitting did not preserve the whole decoder.
No completed down-only compact carrier comparison was found in the existing protocols.
Keeping G/U preserves their nonlinear feature map at a given input. Earlier changed D outputs can still alter later-layer inputs.
human_direction: Prior art supplies usable tools and comparison boundaries, and is not an independent rejection criterion. Established compression may supply a carrier for a new continual framework; neither using it in this setting nor renaming it establishes novelty.

arms.WeightD: Ordinary FP32 SVD of each original 896x4864 D; rank200 square-root-balanced factors, then FP16 storage.
arms.ResponseD: Top200 output directions L of uncentered S=mean_QA(mean_sampled_positions(h h^T)), h=D[SiLU(Gx)*Ux]. Project D'=L(L^T D). For C=L^T D=Uc diag(s) Vh, store (L Uc) sqrt(s), sqrt(s) Vh. This balances the same projected D, not a different approximation.

invariant: Only all24 language FFN down projections are physically replaced. Original G/U, attention, vision, projector, embeddings and other weights remain intact and frozen. No original dense D, complete SVD basis, teacher or statistics are required in the final weight package.

data.selection: Exactly the prior gate-response fixed S1 FIT group-hash selection: 32 groups for moments, disjoint16 for local feature diagnosis, one representative QA/group. No content-based reselection.
data.positions: At most64 packed positions per QA selected by the original fixed position hash, identical across24 layers and arms. Full original input is forwarded; no image/token truncation or role balancing.
data.weighting: Each of32 moment QAs has equal weight; positions within a QA have equal weight. Diagnostic error and target energy are each averaged across positions and output coordinates per QA, then averaged over16 QAs; their ratio is reported per layer. No fitting on diagnosis/DEV.
data.teacher: Unadapted original parent only; 32+16 new decoder passes stopped after final FFN, before head/NLL/generation. Original answer_loss packing includes its512-target/EOS policy. No future FIT, official TEST, trained1313 teacher or old trained checkpoint.
data.DEV: Each of2 physical compact graphs generates once on the same100 already-explored DEV IDs. Parent scalars copied only from existing complete VERIFIED proof after state/config/source/per-ID prepared input/ref binding; no parent generation or rescoring.

numerics.parent_and_candidates: Original FP16 base and outer CUDA FP16 autocast, eval; candidate factors stored FP16. No precision search.
numerics.statistics: Stream selected parent h to CPU FP32; uncentered h.T@h with CPU autocast explicitly disabled, divide by sampled positions then32 QAs. Symmetrize before CPU FP32 eigh. Ordinary and small-matrix SVD both CPU FP32 with8 threads. Record actual finite statistics, spectrum and factor layouts.
numerics.limits: 24x896x896 FP32 moments use77070336 tensor bytes, plus bounded current samples and decomposition workspace. This is not a whole-process memory cap. No inverse or full z cache. Real FP16 whole-graph save/reload and answer evaluation determine functionality; real arithmetic formulas imply no bitwise fidelity.

budget_seconds.scope: STARTED to COMPLETE includes loading, hashes, statistics, decompositions, local diagnostics, full saves/reloads, generation and observation; CPU admission, verification, transport and historical cost separate

resource: One genuinely free OLD GPU, all phases serial on that same card. Protect both formal baselines and other users. Restart=no, KillMode=process, no enable.
stop: Any first-STARTED failure, nonfinite, interruption or budget overrun closes this fixed point. No checkpoint continuation, extension, automatic version, rank/LR/QA/recovery search. Only pre-STARTED pre-CUDA resource-change exit75 permits unattempted waiting.
proof: Unique automatic verify only after all3 COMPLETE and successful actual EXIT. Require source/READY/state/input/CP SHA bindings;48 persisted complete capture rows with24 hooks,32 moment+16 diagnosis; finite statistics/factors; physical absence of down_proj.weight; complete counts/strict reload/digests;200 outputs and all original refs; same PID resources and actual single-card budgets. Original token_f1 AST scores the two new sets once. No bootstrap or old rescore.

decision.feasible: Integrity/budgets/actual full compact weight count pass and all five domain point F1 are >= their unadapted parent point F1. User has not specified allowed degradation; no equivalence/noninferiority claim.
decision.selection: If any feasible carrier exists, retain highest macro among feasible arms; exact tie WeightD. WeightD need not lose for a known useful tool to be retained. Publish both arms and all per-domain/per-ID outcomes.
decision.positive: Only a usable starting carrier for a separate finite-budget continuous readout adaptation necessity review. No automatic1213/1313/21454, Ours, novelty or strong-baseline victory. If only WeightD works, do not claim activation-aware selection caused success.
decision.negative: Neither arm preserves the parent floor: close this D-only rank200 point and stop rotating through further matrices. Local reconstruction advantage alone never qualifies.

limits: Explored DEV, one seed,20 QA/domain and89 known groups; pretraining overlap unknown. Unadapted parent is a weak functionality origin, not the strongest trained reference. No isolated cause of OSFT/ShortFixed gains, no proof of full continual learning or permanently unnecessary D weights.
